notablePrerequisites: Optionally, you have another nonland card in hand with the mana to cast it.
description:
Cast any card by paying its mana cost, or wait for an opponent to cast one.
Holding priority, cast Reprieve by paying {1}{W}, targeting that spell.
Swarm Intelligence and Storm-Kiln Artist trigger.
Resolve the Storm-Kiln Artist trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Swarm Intelligence trigger, copying Reprieve, with the copy targeting the original Reprieve.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the copy of Reprieve, returning the original Reprieve to your hand and causing you to draw a card.
Holding priority, activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{W}.
Repeat from step 2.
